author: Faeron1984
quote:
Fundamentally, this is not a Grand Theft Auto game - this is a poorly written Couple On The Run story, with minor improvements to graphics and car modifications over previous editions, and a cheap cameo thrown in to try and nostalgia bait. The HUD is uninspiring and dull to look at, with simple white text such as "+Ammo" appearing when looting corpses, and zero effort put into the weapon wheel compared to Red Dead's stylistic version. The vehicles handle too realistically yet too arcade-y to be enjoyed by either fanbase. There are too many things to complain about, and not enough positives to bother trying to justify this waste of $2bn and 13 years.

The biggest issue is the main story itself. If one were to play this game in a classic GTA fashion, you will inevitably achieve the "bad" endings. This is due to the awful karma system. The game attempts to punish players for their choices, and wants you to simply play-out the developer's ideal choices, rather than allow you to make your own versions of events. In a real GTA game, we would have the option to abandon Lucia entirely, if not outright kill her, as well as commit crime without moral judgement from the developers. I could go on, but this game has already wasted enough of my time.

Do not even get me started about the dodgy user agreement and the data it collects on your behaviour in-game.
